name: band seated hip external rotation
description: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.
